subject.title: feat: add visible session spawn parity

question: Should visible-session cwd support land only with canonical filesystem containment and an active-requester-safe transcript-fork path, rather than the current raw-path Gateway forwarding?
rationale: The intended feature is reasonable, but choosing the durable security and transcript-state contract affects the Gateway boundary and cannot safely be resolved by accepting the current implementation unchanged.

options.title: Repair the parity path
options.body: Canonicalize and verify cwd within the sandbox workspace, use the supported active-session fork path, and add real Gateway proof for success and rejection cases.

options.title: Defer cwd and fork parity
options.body: Land only the independent messaging lifecycle-tool catalog change and defer the security- and session-contract work to a narrower follow-up.

recommendation.title: Repair the parity path
recommendation.body: Canonicalize and verify cwd within the sandbox workspace, use the supported active-session fork path, and add real Gateway proof for success and rejection cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The current PR series owns the proposed agent-tool and Gateway parity implementation.
